description: Offline normalization of verified Maryland licensed-center candidates with separate postal fields, nullable points and explicit source uncertainty.
redirect_policy: No network requests; independently verify retained inputs inside datahub.
retry: No automatic retry or repull. Preserve acquired inputs for inspection and explicit offline reprocessing.
checkpoint: Publish source-linked records, quarantine references and reconciled summary in immutable UUID output with manifest last.
idempotency: Bind exact acquired manifest path/hash/run/mode and transformation version; never overwrite retained inputs or older normalized releases.
cancellation: Cooperative replay and normalization checks with drained owned writes; clean only owned incomplete output and preserve uncertain publication.
retention_profile: Internal candidates and source-linked quarantine references; preserve raw selected evidence, missing-field reasons, February cohort date and unverified reported address/identity.
